approval_scope: offline evidence and exact non-executable Phase 8.9 blueprint; no claim of deployed or live-cloud verification

whole_profile_limitations: An all-GCP whole Twin remains unsupported until the separately owned L4/L5 capability gap is closed; the GCP embedded-event and Event-Layer scopes remain admissible.
All six directed workload-identity exchanges remain live activation gates rather than observed cloud evidence.

pricing_completeness_result.scope: incremental embedded domain-event, Event-Layer, bridge, landing, transfer, retention, workflow, device boundary, and observability costs; not full-profile totals

known_differences: five-layer-baseline@2 embeds mandatory domain-event behavior in ingestion and processing responsibilities; six-layer-eventing@1 owns transport semantics in an independent Eventing responsibility.
Provider bundles are functionally aligned compositions, not one-to-one service equivalents.
Single-cloud paths use the complete local bundle and no bridge; cross-cloud paths use source-owned durable forwarding to the destination broker data plane.
The published cost results are separate event-scope estimates and intentionally do not rank full Twin profiles.

residual_risks.gate: Execute and capture issuer, audience, subject, expiry, destination authorization, and negative-claim tests for all six directed provider pairs.
residual_risks.consequence: A failing direction is unsupported and must block any profile placement that requires it.

residual_risks.gate: Run supervised throughput, backlog, retry, ordering, and failure tests for AWS 400-shard Kinesis, Azure six-CU Dedicated Event Hubs, and GCP 126-worker Large allocations.
residual_risks.consequence: Theoretical capacity is not sufficient to activate a Large deployment.

residual_risks.gate: Pin the reviewed image digest, chart, mTLS/authorization policy, three-node topology, persistence, backup, upgrade, and cleanup ownership in Phase 8.9.
residual_risks.consequence: The provider-hosted MQTT boundary is acceptable for this PoC but is not represented as a managed or production-qualified GCP IoT service.

residual_risks.gate: Keep all-GCP whole-profile resolution fail-closed until the separately owned L4/L5 capability gap has an approved implementation.
residual_risks.consequence: GCP Eventing evidence must not be misreported as an executable all-GCP Twin.

evidence: Exact three-profile boundary and legacy-flag rejection inspected.
Eight domain channels, three single-cloud cases, six directed identity paths, six bridge route classes, and six three-provider placements checked.
Short-lived identity, destination broker data-plane authorization, forbidden public function bridge, activation gates, and 33 component owners checked.
All 60 frozen sources and references passed strict offline verification.
Scenario results reproduced byte-identically with the committed digest.
Twenty calculation and decision-package tests passed, including negative digest, route, ownership, contract, adapter, and secret checks.
Cost remains a visible result and not an admissibility criterion; full-profile ranking remains Phase 8.10.
